_comment: arXiv: primary academic preprint source for deep-research. Provides paper search by category and keyword, abstract fetching, and metadata retrieval. No API key required for basic access. Rate limit: 3 requests/second. This MCP is the default source for all /deep-dive runs.

search_params.search_query: Use field prefixes: ti: (title), abs: (abstract), all: (all fields), cat: (category)

_usage.response_format: Atom XML — parse with xml2js or similar
_usage.fetch_paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/{arxiv_id} for abstract page, https://arxiv.org/pdf/{arxiv_id} for PDF
_usage.rate_limit: 3 requests per second; add 0.35s delay between requests
